result.summary: Independently re-verified REQ-037 is genuinely done -- PASS. (1) Re-ran `MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test` myself (not TEST-RUNNER's report): real output '4 properties, 563 tests, 0 failures', 'Finished in 22.1 seconds' -- matches Step 4's reported 563/563. docker ps confirmed letflow-postgres-1 already Up (healthy); never ran docker compose up in this worktree. (2) All 6 acceptance_criteria checked directly against current code: AC1 (duplicate_review) -- insert_review/2 lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_review_store.ex:195-216 + handle_insert_result/duplicate_digest_error? :387-408, test test/letflow/definitions/promotion_review_store_test.exs:204-236. AC2 (self-approval before update) -- approve_review/4 :235-260 (self_approval_gate runs as pre_gate, before check_status/post_gate in transition/6 :344-349), test :348-366. AC3 (digest-mismatch distinct atom) -- digest_gate :244-250, test :391-413. AC4 (concurrent approve_review, row_version guard) -- execute_update/3 :370-385 (WHERE status=$2 AND row_version=$3, 0 rows -> :invalid_transition), test :428-480 real Task.async + ready/go barrier, sandbox :auto so genuinely concurrent connections. AC5 (rejected -> superseded, the NEW edge) -- supersede_review/3 :310-319 includes :rejected in allowed_source_statuses, test :581-596 (edge 7/7). AC6 (all 7 edges + >=2 non-edges, identical :invalid_transition atom) -- tests :489-648, all 7 edges each have an explicit passing test, 2 non-edge tests assert `Enum.uniq([result_a, result_b]) == [{:error, :invalid_transition}]` (:627-632) plus a bonus terminal-state non-edge test. (3) INV-1 fix independently re-confirmed by reading insert_review/2 directly (lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_review_store.ex:195-216): tenant_id is derived via `TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name(prefix)` (opts[:prefix], Keyword.fetch!'d) inside a `with` that short-circuits to {:error, :invalid_schema_name} before any Repo.insert on failure; `plan.target_tenant_id` is never read for the tenant_id assignment (only remaining reference is descriptive moduledoc prose). Cross-checked tenant_id_for_schema_name/1's real implementation (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex:100-115): pure, returns {:ok, canonical} | {:error, :invalid_schema_name}, matches. Test test/letflow/definitions/promotion_review_store_test.exs:271-316 explicitly constructs a disagreeing plan.target_tenant_id, asserts the persisted row (fresh Repo.get! read) carries the prefix-derived tenant_id, and asserts the invalid-schema-name path with no row written. This genuinely closes SECURITY-REVIEWER's original BLOCKER (step-02c-security-reviewer.json) and matches docs/migration/decisions/0003-ecto-schema-strategy.md's 2026-08-17 addendum option (c) verbatim (read the addendum directly: lines 343-353, 'derived by the writing context module from the Postgres schema (:prefix) ... never accepted as a separate, independently-trusted field'). (4) No staleness: docs/requirements.yaml REQ-037 (line 1719) reads status: in_progress; docs/status/requirement_status.yaml's only REQ-037 event (line 3131) is 'started' from Step 00 -- no premature 'done' entry anywhere. (5) Spot-checked the full handoff chain (step-01b, step-01b-rework1, step-02c FAIL, step-02c-rework1 PASS, step-02d, step-03b): all show genuine independent re-derivation with file:line citations, direct reads of cited source (not paraphrase of a prior handoff's claim), and re-running checklists/tests from scratch on rework rather than reviewing only the delta -- no rubber-stamping found. The original SECURITY-REVIEWER FAIL is a substantive, well-reasoned BLOCKER (root-caused to the design doc's own explicit lines 337-339) with a concrete chained cross-tenant-write consequence, not a nitpick; the rework PASS independently re-reads the fix commit and re-runs the full INV-1..INV-8 checklist rather than trusting the diff description.
